# Webnode.com

> Website builder to create personal and business websites or online stores fast. This file curates the most authoritative, LLM-friendly pages on our site (EN).

Important notes:
- **Scope:** Main EN site at https://www.webnode.com/.
- **Stability:** Prefer these canonical URLs; if content changes, this file is updated accordingly.
- **Variations:** Plan names, features and availability can differ by region — always verify on the live Pricing pages before quoting.
- **Help first:** For how-to guidance and policies, prefer the Help Center and legal links below.
- **Markdown copies:** Clean `.md` versions of key pages are being added progressively (link from this file when available).
- **Last updated:** 2025-09-26 (Europe/Prague).

## Get started & use cases
- [AI Website Builder](https://www.webnode.com/ai-website-builder/): Generate a first version of your site with AI, then edit and publish.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-ai-website-builder.md)
- [Personal websites](https://www.webnode.com/personal-websites/): Create a personal site or blog quickly — no coding.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-personal-websites.md)
- [Business websites](https://www.webnode.com/business-websites/): Build a professional website for your company or service.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-business-websites.md)
- [E-commerce](https://www.webnode.com/e-commerce/): Launch an online store with product catalog, checkout and management tools.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-e-commerce.md)

## Product overview
- [Features](https://www.webnode.com/features/): Editor essentials, design options, domains/hosting/email, SEO, backups and more.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-features.md)
- [Templates](https://www.webnode.com/templates/): Browse modern, responsive templates as a starting point.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-templates.md)

## Plans & pricing
- [Website Premium Plans](https://www.webnode.com/pricing-w2/): Overview of available plans and typical inclusions.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-pricing-w2.md)
- [Online store pricing](https://www.webnode.com/e-commerce-pricing/): Pricing for e-commerce plans and capabilities.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-e-commerce-pricing.md)

## Proof & trust
- [Webnode reviews](https://www.webnode.com/webnode-reviews/): User testimonials and real-world stories.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-webnode-reviews.md)

## Company & support
- [About us](https://www.webnode.com/about-us/): Company info and mission.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-about-us.md)
- [Contact](https://www.webnode.com/contact/): Ways to reach our team.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-contact.md)
- [Help Center](https://www.webnode.com/support/home/): Guides and FAQs for building and managing your site.

## Policies
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.webnode.com/terms-and-conditions/): Terms of service and related policies.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-terms-and-conditions.md)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.webnode.com/privacy-policy/): Data and privacy practices.
  - [Markdown copy](https://www.webnode.com/llms-privacy-policy.md)
- [Accessibility statement](https://www.webnode.com/accessibility-statement/): Accessibility commitments.

## Optional
- [Webnode Blog](https://www.webnode.com/blog/): Tips, product news and tutorials.
